figurative_meaning_en: feeling restless due to suppressed emotions
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গোপন রহস্যটা বলতে না পেরে দম ফাটা হয়ে উঠেছে।
কথাটা মনে রেখে দম ফাটা অবস্থায় সে বসে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She was bursting with impatience, unable to share the secret.
He sat there, fit to burst from holding back his feelings.
note: The idiom vividly captures the physical sensation of emotional pressure in Bengali expressive culture.
